main_text.l: viores. Nempe quòd illa nefariè con-
torta, mutilata, à fensu & scopo Cal-
vini aliena à Jesuitis citantur: quòd
num negare, cui ille subscripsit: quòd
quòd dicitur Filium, quâ Deum, Patri
is plus quàm centies ὁμοούσιον Patris &
Filii confessus fuerit: quòd dicitur Fi-
nistrum Patris, cùm hæc in ipsius
nobis caussa, cur coram tota Ecclesia

page.notes: The Greek word ὁμοούσιον is printed as "ovvʼoσíαν" in a degraded form; rendered as best readable. The catchword "in" is taken from the lower right.
